INNER HEAD. [3] [Cimx.]
Headache of the most violent kind. θ Intermittent.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Cimx.]
Chronic liver complaint.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Cimx.]
Hemorrhoidal complaints ; hemorrhoidal pains with stool.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Cimx.]
Hamstrings feel too short, knees are flexed ; attempting to stretch them causes pain in thighs. θ During chill.
   

FEVER. [40] [Cimx.]
During chilliness all her joints are painful, as if tendons were too short.
Tertian and quartan intermittent.
